sourceFindings.identity: Folia black drawing/craft paper, 130 g/m², 50 × 70 cm, 100 sheets. Betzold 80001IN; primary web-rendered page confirms manufacturer Max Bringmann/Folia and black colour.

review.quality: Whole black top sheet and stacked edge are visible with no people. However at 1:1 the sheet surface resolves as broad blocky/compressed patches and lower/left edges are soft with repeated coarse stair-step halos. The 2048² canvas does not provide sharp useful zoom detail. Do not treat dimensions alone as compliance; no external upscale proven, but genuine high-detail capture not established.
review.exactIdentity: Original ATEHNA page explicitly identifies black B 2, 130 g and through-coloured paper. Its original black photo is compatible in tone, and no maker is stated. Current database 707 × 500 mm derives from ISO B 2 import, while source merely names B 2; this 50 × 70 cm supplier format is a plausible nominal-format match, not proof that 700 equals 707. No dimensions or product facts changed.
review.views: Single photograph only. Linked MM 343 × 281 and BL 180 × 149 repeat the capture, not additional angles.
